[[File:TandinLaserLance-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|General [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]] wielding a laser lance]]
A '''laser lance''' was a weapon used by the forces of the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The laser lance was able to be used both as a melee weapon, as well as a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]; blue energy would cascade from the golden capacitor above the hand grip to flow along the length of the lance to the tip, before discharging as a blue blaster bolt.<ref name="TIP">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>
